notes.title: Endless Survival Update
notes.content:
Enable [b]endless survival[/b] in the single-player world map or in the multi-player host lobby. Enemies keep coming until you can't take it anymore! You get to keep all loot that drop after the normal waves.

Notes:
[list]
[*]Endless survival mode added
[*]Unreal Engine updated by many versions, providing with lots of bug fixes and improvements to the underlaying tech
[*]Some balance adjustments, new music and bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: New Update Released
notes.content:
Update notes:
[list]
[*]The last level of the campaign added.
[*]Procedurally generated random campaigns added. Unlocked when you have completed the first Africa level.
[*]Single-player is now paused when the menu is open.
[*]Most English texts improved.
[*]Bug fixes, music improvements, and other adjustments...
[/list]

notes.title: New update released!
notes.content:
Release notes v0.5.2:
- New level. Scary boss!
- CPU and GPU performance optimizations for better FPS.
- Network performance optimizations for smoother multi-player.
- Adjustments and improvements to some tower and enemy models.
- Additional upgrade level added for Laser Turret in nightmare difficulty. It's automatically available if Laser Turret is equipped in the inventory and you're playing nightmare, just like some other craft tower upgrades.
- Player colors adjusted.

notes.title: Update 0.5.1
notes.content:
New update released!

Release notes v0.5.1:
- New infantry assets. More detailed models and better animations.
- New commander voices.
- New commander portraits.
- Some performance optimizations. We'll continue optimizing the game in the following patches.
- Bug fix: A tentative fix for the endless splitter slimes bug. Please let us know if this problem still happens, since we are not completely sure about the cause.

notes.title: Update 0.5.0
notes.content:
New early access update released with extra content!

Release notes v0.5.0:
- New levels and enemies! Please check [b]Chapter 5[/b].
- 2 new menu themes. The first four chapters must be completed on certain difficulties to unlock them.
- More building space added to Trench, Counter strike and Isle of man.
- Bug fix: Quick sell tool tip shows the correct key now.
- Tower's clip size is visible in the HUD when selected.
- Other minor adjustments and bug fixes.

notes.title: Update 0.4.4
notes.content:
The second EA update is now released!

Release notes v0.4.4:
- An additional inventory slot added where only crafted items can be equipped. With this change we want to promote the craft towers a bit and make them feel less like a compromise.
- Added "Show only crafted items" inventory filter.
- Balancing: Dr. Kuspov's wirefence cost reduced from 10 to 8.
- Balancing: Rheinmetall max tower amount limitation removed.
- Bug fix: Spider shield effect fixed. Sometimes it disappeared visually too soon.
- Most aircraft models reworked or adjusted for better visual quality.
- Serpent and scorpion visual adjustments.
- Clarified inventory and ability menu navigation.
- The selected commander is always visible in the navigation bar.
- Added "Next chapter" buttons to the level selection map for faster navigation between the chapters.
- Added legend to the level selection map for clarification.
- Some level assets improved.
- Bug fix/feature adjustment: Non-blocking towers (Kuspov's ability turrets, Armor smelter, Plane crash wall) can be built even when they are overlapping enemies. This fixes also Kuspov's ability turrets going to cooldown but not appearing.
- Kuspov's ability turret model reworked.
- Bug fix: Some achievements were not registered for the host sometimes in multi-player.
- Added a possibility to quick sell towers by holding down the "sell" hotkey ("S" by default) and clicking towers.
- "Counter strike" level layout changed.

notes.title: Update 0.4.3
notes.content:
Our first early access update is here!

Release notes v0.4.3:
- Graphics improvements: Most enemy vehicle models reworked. We'll continue with other assets in the following updates.
- Loot boxes stay longer.
- More visible loot boxes. There's now a spotlight looking indicator. We didn't add any sounds for common and uncommon boxes because lots of those drop in the later stages.
- Some repetitive sounds are played less frequently.
- Inventory items show which commanders they boost when hovered.
- Some inventory item descriptions are clarified.
- The amount of different materials is reduced. In case you have some existing materials in your inventory that are not useful anymore, you should just sell them. The [i]Sell excess materials[/i] button might be helpful.
- Bug fix: Revenant doesn't heal other revenants anymore when they are at the same location.


Coming soon:
- More quality improvements.
- Better commander portraits.
- Inventory improvements.
- Crafting system adjustments.


Coming later:
- More performance optimizations.
- More content.

notes.title: Bunker Defense Demo
notes.content:
[h2]Hello![/h2]

Bunker Defense is a new tower defense game, that follows the classical top down concept, but aims to be the best tower defense game ever!

Some of the features:
[list]
[*] Single-player and multi-player co-op.
[*] Lots of depth and countless ways to build and improve your defenses as you progress.
[*] Maze building - you can build complex mazes for the enemies.
[/list]

[h2]Demo[/h2]

For this Game Festival, an updated version of Bunker Defense demo is available for [i]Windows[/i] and [i]Mac OS X[/i].

The demo contains 13 levels, so there's plenty to play. It also contains three difficulties out of four. [i]Nightmare[/i] difficulty is included only in the full game, containing new special enemies and a completely different game experience.

Aside from the limited content, the demo contains all features of the full game, like the multi-player co-op mode.

[h2]Devs[/h2]

We are tower defense enthusiasts from Finland. Bunker Defense is our second game after [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/350620/Sandmason/]Sandmason[/url], and we have been developing it for over three years now.

We hope you like the demo! The full game will be released as Early Access soon after the Game Festival.
